what_this_is: Published dry and propellant masses for flown launch vehicle stages, used to check whether this project's structural mass model sits in the regime real hardware occupies.
definition: structural_coefficient = dry_kg / (dry_kg + propellant_kg), matching cadflow.planner: structs = prop * s / (1 - s).
provenance_warning: These are SECONDARY-SOURCE figures from published vehicle descriptions and user guides, not primary mass statements from the manufacturers. Individual values are quoted differently across sources -- Saturn V S-II dry mass appears as both 36,000 and 40,100 kg, and Falcon 9 stage masses are not officially published at all. Each entry carries a confidence flag and a spread where sources disagree. Nothing here is test data, no value has been verified against a primary document, and this file must not be used as a design allowable or a validation of flight mass. It supports one claim only: whether a modelled structural coefficient is in the right decade as flown hardware.
how_to_improve: Replace each entry with a figure traceable to a manufacturer payload user's guide or a NASA/ESA technical report, and record the document number in `source_note`.
